description: This header file declares functions and includes related to handling Zigbee events within the Zigbee subsystem of a device, including initialization, system readiness, and discovery status notifications.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerInit
methods.description: Registers event handling callbacks with the system.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerSystemReady
methods.description: Notifies the event handler that the system is ready to handle events.

methods.name: zigbeeEventHandlerDiscoveryRunning
methods.description: Informs the event handler about the start or stop of device discovery.
